subject: design/installer-v1
statement: Every file a release installs carries one of three ownership classes — **engine-verbatim** (converge repairs byte-exact), **repo-owned** (converge validates against its closed schema, never rewrites), **generated** (converge regenerates) — assigned by an **authored class-policy file** committed in the source repo (the human input, AP-24); the release build walks the payload against it and derives the manifest (the aggregate, AP-27). A payload file the policy does not class **fails the release build** (DINV-6). The concrete schemas live in this design's solution shape.
